ns2:course.label: Introduction to Archaeology
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the problems of studying past cultures; special attention given to the ranges of techniques available and the adequacy of various methodologies as bases for sound inference about the structure of extinct cultures. Prerequisite: ANTH 102 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ANTH 102 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
